dimensions.note: No credentials. The only external value is the public Swamp Club URL; the tracked username is not a secret. No vault refs needed.
Structured placeholders on both methods ('Sampled {user}: {score} lifetime, {today} today' and 'Pulse: {n} sample(s), {gained} net points over window'). No interpolation and no sensitive data.

fetchSample sets AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs), checks res.ok (throws HTTP status), verifies the profile exists, and requires an alltime board row before writing. pulse throws a clear message when no samples exist yet.

club_pulse_test.ts covers bucketKey (all granularities), computeBuckets (first-bucket seeding, delta attribution, negative corrections), buildPulse (span/net totals and empty buffer), renderPulseMarkdown, and renderPulseHtml (self-contained HTML with no external URLs, plus the empty state).

sample is intentionally not idempotent (it is an append-only time series); re-running it appends a near-duplicate sample and the documented cadence is the mitigation. pulse is read-only over the buffer and overwrites the same outputs. Non-blocking and by design for a velocity sampler.

GET {clubUrl}/api/v1/leaderboard/locate?q=<username> returns a boards map; the model tolerates missing boards/rows (nulls/zeros) and only hard-fails when the alltime row is absent. Same endpoint as the prior-art swamp-club-score extension.
The fetch carries a timeout so a hung request cannot leak. No temp files in the model; the bundled pulse-view.sh writes its own temp HTML and opens/prints it.
README uses a 'your-name' placeholder for username and the public swamp-club.com URL. Test fixtures use maphew and a tier name, no real hostnames, IPs, or account identifiers.
All schemas are plain z.object(...) with no .passthrough(); CEL validation works. username is now required (no personal default).
samples is infinite/5 (time-series history), pulse infinite/10, and the report/dashboard files infinite/10. maxSamples caps the buffer and the dropped counter records evictions.
Not a CRUD lifecycle model — an append-only sampler plus a derived report.
sample writes only local data; there is no external mutation to gate.
sample writes samples-current; pulse writes pulse-current, pulse-report-current, and pulse-dashboard. Unique per spec with no cross-method collisions.
sample and pulse read the prior buffer via ctx.readResource('samples-current') with a defensive optional fallback, rather than reaching into the data repository.
First publish (2026.10.14.1); no prior published instances to migrate, so no upgrades chain is required. The workflow is namespaced @maphew/club-pulse per registry collective rules.

mechanical.schema-write-conformance: pass — SamplesSchema (username, samples, updatedAt, dropped) and PulseSchema are assembled in one place and written; Sample entries always carry all declared fields from LocateRow with null/0 fallbacks.
mechanical.truncation-honesty: pass — the rolling buffer is capped at maxSamples and the number evicted is recorded as dropped, so the report can state resolution/coverage honestly.
mechanical.instance-name-consistency: pass — one writer per instance name (samples-current, pulse-current, pulse-report-current, pulse-dashboard).
mechanical.schema-field-coverage: pass — every declared field has a producing code path; rank/streak/tier fields are explicitly nullable when a board omits them.
